root.label: Federal lawsuit challenges Truth Social paid early access plan

events.label: Federal lawsuit challenges Truth Social paid early access plan

slots.name: early access price
slots.sentence: A lawsuit filed Wednesday in federal court in New York challenges a plan to sell early access to President Trump’s posts on Truth Social for up to $100,000 a month, arguing the First Amendment “guarantees equal access to the President’s public announcements.”

slots.name: customer count
slots.sentence: Truth Social has so far signed up around 10 customers , who would pay up to $100,000 a month.
